prompt: What was David Fincher's most recently released feature film when Britney Spears' first feature film was released in the U.S.?
answer: Britney Spears’s first feature film was **_Longshot_**, released in the U.S. in 2001. At that point, David Fincher’s most recently released feature was **_Fight Club_ (1999)**; his next film, **_Panic Room_**, came out in 2002.
